learning_outcomes.text: To give students an early opportunity to apply the knowledge they have acquired in practice and at the same time to get to know the operational processes in a company.
To recognize that internships in companies during studies and the resulting knowledge are a decisive advantage when starting professional life.
To be involved in current company projects in areas such as development, production, or sales.
To work on projects related to mechanical engineering and related fields, practically applying knowledge acquired at the university.
To gain insight into future professional life.

syllabus_topics: Participation in specific projects in a company, e.g., in the areas of design and development, production, quality management, ...
assessment_rules: The assessment consists of writing a scientific report. This assessment is ungraded.
